scenes.title: Form the LLC
scenes.summary: The agent forms a Texas LLC for a fictional firm, one step at a time. The engine stops it where a person must approve or sign, and the first filing dates go on a calendar.

steps.output:
Created firm
  firm.json, decisions.json, progress.json, artifacts.json, log.jsonl
steps.caption: A firm folder is created on the operator's own machine for Example Industrial LLC, a fictional firm not formed yet. Only its name is known; the entity's facts start empty.

steps.output:
Started form-sponsor-entity (syndication · industrial · us-federal, us-tx): 12 steps apply.
  next: pcre run next form-sponsor-entity
steps.caption: The agent starts the formation playbook. Read for a syndication sponsor in Texas, 12 of its 16 steps apply.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity choose-state-and-entity-type --by counsel --proof drafts/entity-choice-memo.pdf
steps.output:
choose-state-and-entity-type: done by counsel on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 1 done of 12
ready now: check-name-texas, line-up-registered-agent, sign-company-agreement
steps.caption: The first step is counsel's: the state and the entity type. Counsel recorded it under its own name, with where the memo is.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity check-name-texas --proof drafts/name-check-results.pdf
steps.output: "check-name-texas" is covered by the run's standing approval, and none is recorded yet. Ask a person once for this run, and wait. Once they say yes, record it in their name: pcre run approve form-sponsor-entity --by "<name>". Or record this step alone with --approved-by "<name>" once they approve it.
steps.caption: The agent tried the name check, a step it does in a browser. The step needs the run's standing approval, and no one had given it, so the engine refused.

steps.output: Alex Example approved form-sponsor-entity on 2026-11-17. Covers: check-name-texas.
steps.caption: Alex Example gave the run's standing approval, once. It covers the name check.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity check-name-texas --proof drafts/name-check-results.pdf
steps.output:
check-name-texas: done by agent on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 2 done of 12
ready now: line-up-registered-agent, sign-company-agreement
steps.caption: With the approval on record, the agent checked the name and recorded where the search results are.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity line-up-registered-agent --by "Alex Example" --proof drafts/zenbusiness-registered-agent-consent.pdf
steps.output:
line-up-registered-agent: done by Alex Example on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 3 done of 12
ready now: draft-certificate, sign-company-agreement
steps.caption: Alex Example lined up ZenBusiness as the registered agent, a person's step, and recorded where its written consent is.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity draft-certificate --proof drafts/certificate-of-formation-draft.pdf
steps.output:
draft-certificate: done by agent on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 4 done of 12
ready now: file-texas-certificate, sign-company-agreement
steps.caption: The agent drafted the certificate of formation and recorded where the draft is.

steps.output: "file-texas-certificate" is a step a person does (human-online, principal). Prepare it, then hand it to them: say what to do and where, and wait. Once they say it is done, record it in their name: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity file-texas-certificate --by "<name>"
steps.caption: The agent tried to record the filing. Signing and filing the certificate is a person's step, so the engine refused and told the agent to hand it over.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity file-texas-certificate --by "Alex Example" --proof drafts/zenbusiness-filing-confirmation.pdf
steps.output:
file-texas-certificate: done by Alex Example on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 5 done of 12
ready now: sign-company-agreement, confirm-boi-status, complete-franchise-questionnaire
steps.caption: Alex Example signed the certificate and filed it through ZenBusiness, then recorded the step under their own name, with where the filing confirmation is.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity sign-company-agreement --by "Alex Example" --proof drafts/company-agreement-signed.pdf
steps.output:
sign-company-agreement: done by Alex Example on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 6 done of 12
ready now: confirm-boi-status, prepare-ein-answers, complete-franchise-questionnaire
steps.caption: Alex Example recorded the signed company agreement, another step a person signs.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity confirm-boi-status --proof drafts/fincen-boi-page.pdf
steps.output:
confirm-boi-status: done by agent on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 7 done of 12
ready now: prepare-ein-answers, complete-franchise-questionnaire
steps.caption: The agent confirmed that no beneficial ownership report is due and recorded where the page it read is saved.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity prepare-ein-answers --proof drafts/ein-application-answers.pdf
steps.output:
prepare-ein-answers: done by agent on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 8 done of 12
ready now: apply-for-ein, complete-franchise-questionnaire
steps.caption: The agent prepared the answers for the EIN application and recorded where they are.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity apply-for-ein --by "Alex Example" --proof drafts/ein-confirmation-letter.pdf
steps.output:
apply-for-ein: done by Alex Example on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 9 done of 12
ready now: complete-franchise-questionnaire, open-bank-account
steps.caption: Alex Example applied for the EIN online. The record holds only where the confirmation letter is kept, never the number.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity complete-franchise-questionnaire --by "Alex Example" --proof drafts/franchise-questionnaire-confirmation.pdf
steps.output:
complete-franchise-questionnaire: done by Alex Example on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 10 done of 12
ready now: calendar-annual-filings, open-bank-account
steps.caption: Alex Example completed the Comptroller's franchise tax questionnaire and recorded where the confirmation is.

steps.output:
Added 3, already on the calendar 0.
  + 2027-05-17  Texas franchise tax report and Public Information Report due (2027)  [texas-franchise-report-2027-05-17]
  + 2028-05-15  Texas franchise tax report and Public Information Report due (2028)  [texas-franchise-report-2028-05-15]
  + 2029-05-15  Texas franchise tax report and Public Information Report due (2029)  [texas-franchise-report-2029-05-15]
Every computed date is flagged for review: check it against its rule before relying on it.
steps.caption: The engine worked out three years of Texas franchise tax report dates from the rule, the first report in 2027, each flagged for a person to check. May 15, 2027 is a Saturday, so that date moves to the Monday.

steps.output:
Wrote 3 events to firm/calendar.ics
Import it into your calendar app; export again after any change.
steps.caption: The dates were written to a calendar file that any calendar app can import.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity calendar-annual-filings --proof calendar.ics
steps.output:
calendar-annual-filings: done by agent on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is open: 11 done of 12
ready now: open-bank-account
steps.caption: The agent recorded the calendar step, with the calendar file it had just written as the proof.

steps.command: pcre run done form-sponsor-entity open-bank-account --by "Alex Example" --proof drafts/mercury-account-confirmation.pdf
steps.output:
open-bank-account: done by Alex Example on 2026-11-17
form-sponsor-entity is complete: 12 done of 12
Nothing left.
steps.caption: Alex Example opened the entity's account at Mercury, the last step and one a person signs. Every step that applies is done, and the run is complete.
